ja.strength: 小規模店から大企業まで同じ基盤で成長でき、決済と2万超のアプリを含む豊富なパートナー網を持つ。
ja.risks: 加盟店や消費の減速、決済損失、競争、障害、クラウド費、アプリ・決済・AIなど外部事業者への依存が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: 通販サイト作成、実店舗POS、決済、マーケットプレイス、加盟店の内製システムと幅広く競う。
ja.relationships: 加盟店へ販売・決済基盤を提供し、アプリ開発者や制作会社が機能を拡張し、決済・クラウド会社が処理基盤を支える。

en.business: Provides a commerce platform that combines online, retail and social selling with inventory, payments and marketing.
en.revenue: Earns from Subscription Solutions and from Merchant Solutions such as payments, transaction-linked services and financial products.
en.strength: One platform can scale from small sellers to large brands, reinforced by payments and an ecosystem of more than 20,000 apps.
en.risks: Merchant or consumer weakness, payment losses, competition, outages, cloud costs and dependence on app, payments and AI providers can affect profits.
en.competition: Competes across storefront software, retail POS, payments, marketplaces and merchants' internally built systems.
en.relationships: Provides selling and payment tools to merchants; developers and agencies extend the platform while payment and cloud providers support processing.

en.risks: Apple or Google policy and identifier changes, privacy rules, ad demand, model performance and dependence on a few distribution platforms can move results sharply.
en.competition: Competes for advertiser budgets and inventory with major advertising and app platforms including Google, Meta, Amazon and Unity.
en.relationships: Matches advertiser bids to app, web and CTV inventory while operating under the policies of distribution platforms such as Apple and Google.

ja.business: 住宅などの宿泊先、体験、旅行中のサービスを提供するホストと利用者を結ぶ世界的な旅行市場。
ja.revenue: 予約金額に対するサービス料が中心で、宿泊開始時に売上を認識する。2025年からホスト側の単一料金へ移行を始めた。
ja.strength: 世界中の多様な宿泊在庫と強いブランド、ホストとゲストが互いを呼ぶネットワーク、決済・安全支援を一体で持つ。
ja.risks: 短期賃貸規制、安全事故、不正、旅行需要の変動、ホスト不足、保険・決済費、地域ごとの法令が成長を左右する。
ja.competition: ホストとゲストをめぐり、オンライン旅行会社、ホテル、検索サービス、体験予約サイトと競う。
ja.relationships: ホストの宿泊・体験・サービスをゲストへ仲介し、カード網、銀行、決済会社を通じて代金を回収・送金する。

en.business: Runs a global travel marketplace connecting guests with hosts offering homes, experiences and trip services.
en.revenue: Earns mainly service fees tied to bookings and recognizes revenue at check-in; it began shifting toward a host-only single-fee structure in 2025.
en.strength: Combines diverse global inventory, a strong brand, host-guest network effects, payments and trust support.
en.risks: Short-term rental rules, safety incidents, fraud, travel demand, host supply, insurance, payments and local laws can constrain growth.
en.competition: Competes for hosts and guests with online travel agencies, hotels, search services and experiences marketplaces.
en.relationships: Matches host stays, experiences and services with guests and uses card networks, banks and processors to collect and remit payments.

ja.business: 音楽、ポッドキャスト、オーディオブックを個人ごとに推薦して配信する世界的な音声サービス。
ja.revenue: Premiumなどの月額契約が中心で、無料版では音声・動画・表示広告を広告主や代理店へ販売する。
ja.strength: 大きな利用者基盤と再生データを使った推薦、無料版から有料版へ移す導線、複数音声形式を一つに集める点が強い。
ja.risks: レーベル・出版社への権利料、契約更新、Appleなど端末基盤との競争、値上げ・解約、広告市況が利益を左右する。
ja.competition: 音声利用時間と広告費をめぐり、Apple、Alphabet、Amazon、Meta、ByteDanceなどのサービスと競う。
ja.relationships: レーベル、出版社、制作者から音源・番組の権利を得て利用者へ配信し、通信会社経由でも有料契約を販売する。

en.business: Streams personalized music, podcasts and audiobooks to users worldwide.
en.revenue: Earns mainly monthly Premium and related subscriptions, while the free service sells audio, video and display ads to brands and agencies.
en.strength: A large user base, personalization data, free-to-paid conversion and multiple audio formats reinforce engagement.
en.risks: Label and publisher royalties, contract renewals, competition from device platforms, price-related churn and ad markets can affect profits.
en.competition: Competes for listening time and advertising with services from Apple, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, ByteDance and others.
en.relationships: Licenses music and programs from labels, publishers and creators, distributes them to listeners and also sells subscriptions through telecom partners.
